# Metadata fixtures (spec 0004, AC17, AC27)

Written from the shapes recorded by the live probes (spec 0004 "Facts vs.
assumptions", 2026-10-07). IDs, titles, names and UUIDs are fakes; keys and
value types are the recorded ones. `track_*` variants differ from `track.json`
in one field each; `error_server_500.json` is made up. Page files are small;
the tests build longer ones (250 items) from `track.json`.
